title: 'Bigger than Barack Obama's election': Scholars reflect on Mississippi Senate race
text:
Politics

'Bigger than Barack Obama's election': Scholars reflect on Mississippi Senate race

Tonya Mosley

FA: Eddie Glaude Jr. & Kiese Laymon

Download

Embed

< iframe src="https://www.npr.org/player/embed/nx-s1-6047338/nx-s1-10011810" width="100%" height="290" frameborder="0" scrolling="no" title="NPR embedded audio player">

Transcript

Scott Colom is now this Southern state's first Black U.S. senator in nearly 150 years. Scholars and Mississippi natives Eddie Glaude and Kiese Laymon discuss the historic significance of his victory.
